items.title: status shows completed sprint as Currently running
items.intent: aishore status must never show a sprint as currently running unless one is actively in progress. A completed or idle sprint.json must produce no Currently running section.
steps: In cmd-status.sh line ~69, change the condition from `sprint_status != idle` to `sprint_status == in_progress` so only actively running sprints show the Currently running section
Verify: status should hide the Currently running section when sprint.json status is completed, failed, idle, or any non-in_progress value

acceptanceCriteria.text: status does not show Currently running when sprint.json status is completed
status shows Currently running only when a sprint is actively in progress
acceptanceCriteria.verify: echo "{\"status\": \"in_progress\", \"item\": {\"id\": \"TEST-1\", \"title\": \"test\"}}" > /tmp/test_sprint.json && orig=$(cat backlog/sprint.json) && cp /tmp/test_sprint.json backlog/sprint.json && result=$(.aishore/aishore status 2>&1) && echo "$orig" > backlog/sprint.json && echo "$result" | grep -qi currently.running

items.groomingNotes: Steps updated: fix is == in_progress (not running) since create_sprint writes in_progress. AC2 verify updated to use in_progress test payload to match actual sprint status values.

items.title: sprint.json retains completed status after sprint finishes
items.intent: After any sprint completes (pass or fail), sprint.json must be reset to idle state so subsequent runs start clean and status commands reflect reality. A stale completed or failed status in sprint.json must never persist between sprints.
steps: In the orchestrator (.aishore/aishore), locate where sprint completion is finalized (after archive write and merge/no-merge path)
After the sprint is fully archived, write {"status": "idle"} to backlog/sprint.json
Ensure this happens in both the pass path and fail path so no residual status persists

acceptanceCriteria.text: sprint.json shows idle status after a sprint completes

items.groomingNotes: Complements BUG-152 (condition fix in cmd-status.sh). This is the root cleanup: ensure sprint.json is always left in idle state after a sprint. AC verify naturally fails before fix (current state is completed) and passes after the fix runs a sprint to completion.
